wikidot5e:spell:dispel-magic.effectSummary: Choose a creature, object, or magical effect in range. Every spell of 3rd level or lower on it ends. For each spell of 4th level or higher, make a spellcasting-ability check against DC 10 + that spell's level; on a success it ends. If you use a slot of 4th level or higher, a spell on the target ends automatically when its level is no higher than the slot you used.

wikidot5e:spell:dissonant-whispers.effectSummary: One creature in range that can hear you makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it takes 3d6 psychic damage and, if its reaction is available, must immediately use it to move as far as its speed permits away from you without entering obviously dangerous ground. On a success it takes half damage and need not move. A deafened creature automatically succeeds. Each slot level above 1st adds 1d6 damage.

wikidot5e:spell:distort-value.effectSummary: Touch an object no more than 1 foot on a side and use illusion either to double its perceived value with attractive flourishes or halve its perceived value with apparent damage. A creature examining it must succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to see through the illusion. Each slot level above 1st increases the maximum object dimension by 1 foot.

wikidot5e:spell:divination.effectSummary: Ask a deity or divine servants one question about a specific goal, event, or activity that will occur within 7 days. The DM gives a truthful response, possibly as a short phrase, cryptic rhyme, or omen. The answer does not account for later circumstances that could change the outcome. If cast more than once before your next long rest, each casting after the first has a cumulative 25% chance of a random reading; the DM rolls secretly.

wikidot5e:spell:divine-word.effectSummary: Choose any number of visible creatures in range. Each that can hear you makes a Charisma save. On a failure, effects depend on current HP: 50 or fewer—deafened 1 minute; 40 or fewer—deafened and blinded 10 minutes; 30 or fewer—blinded, deafened, and stunned 1 hour; 20 or fewer—killed instantly. Regardless of HP, a celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend that fails is forced to its plane of origin if not already there and cannot return to your current plane for 24 hours except by wish.

wikidot5e:spell:dominate-beast.effectSummary: A visible beast in range makes a Wisdom save, with advantage if you or your allies are fighting it, or is charmed for the duration. While charmed and on the same plane, you share a telepathic link and can issue simple general commands while conscious without an action; once an order is completed and no new direction is given, it defends and preserves itself. You can use your action to take total precise control until the end of your next turn, choosing all its actions and using your own reaction if you make it use a reaction. Whenever it takes damage it repeats the Wisdom save, ending the spell on a success. A 5th-level slot lasts up to 10 minutes, 6th up to 1 hour, and 7th or higher up to 8 hours, all with concentration.

wikidot5e:spell:dominate-monster.effectSummary: A visible creature in range makes a Wisdom save, with advantage if you or your allies are fighting it, or is charmed for the duration. While charmed and on the same plane, you share a telepathic link and can issue simple general commands while conscious without an action; after completing an order with no new direction, it defends and preserves itself. You can use your action to take total precise control until the end of your next turn, choosing all its actions and spending your own reaction if you make it use a reaction. Whenever it takes damage it repeats the Wisdom save, ending the spell on a success. A 9th-level slot extends the concentration duration to up to 8 hours.

wikidot5e:spell:dominate-person.effectSummary: A visible humanoid in range makes a Wisdom save, with advantage if you or your allies are fighting it, or is charmed for the duration. While charmed and on the same plane, you share a telepathic link and can issue simple general commands while conscious without an action; after completing an order with no new direction, it defends and preserves itself. You can use your action to take total precise control until the end of your next turn, choosing all its actions and spending your own reaction if you make it use a reaction. Whenever it takes damage it repeats the Wisdom save, ending the spell on a success. A 6th-level slot lasts up to 10 minutes, 7th up to 1 hour, and 8th or higher up to 8 hours, all with concentration.

wikidot5e:spell:draconic-transformation.effectSummary: For the duration you gain three benefits. Blindsight: 30-foot blindsight that functions while blinded or in darkness and reveals invisible creatures unless they successfully hide, but cannot see through total cover. Breath Weapon: when cast and as a bonus action on later turns, exhale a 60-foot cone; creatures there make Dexterity saves, taking 6d8 force damage on a failure or half on a success. Wings: gain a 60-foot flying speed.

wikidot5e:spell:draconic-transformation-.effectSummary: For the duration you gain 30-foot blindsight that functions while blinded or in darkness and reveals invisible creatures unless they successfully hide, though it cannot see through total cover; a 40-foot flying speed from incorporeal wings; and, when cast and as a bonus action on later turns, a 30-foot-cone breath weapon that forces Dexterity saves for 3d8 force damage on a failure or half on a success.
